review_candidates.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: The role As a Cloud & Digital Workplace Engineer, you will be responsible for the administration, support, and optimization of both Azure cloud and on-prem server environments . You will take ownership of incidents, execute infrastructure changes, and contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of core infrastructure services including networking, storage, VMware virtualization, and backup solutions . You will also drive improvements in system performance, security, and cost optimization across both cloud and on-prem platforms. The person You are technically strong, detail-oriented, and capable of managing hybrid infrastructure with minimal supervision. You take initiative in resolving issues and enjoy working on long-term improvements. You are confident in troubleshooting, scripting, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Accountabilities: Digital Workplace These typically relate to on-prem infrastructure, user environments, and hybrid support: Manage and support on-prem server infrastructure (VMs, OS, backups (Commvault, Veeam, Avamar), storage, networking). Troubleshoot complex incidents and root cause issues (e.g., VM performance, connectivity, failed backups). Fulfil advanced service requests (e.g., provisioning, OS installations, SSL renewals, policy configuration). Execute and document changes following ITIL and internal processes. Perform patch management and ensure security compliance across environments. Maintain server security posture (e.g., Defender, firewalls, identity/access). Coordinate maintenance windows and customer communication for planned works. Contribute to monthly/quarterly health reports and environment reviews. Public Cloud These focus on Azure-specific responsibilities and governance: Manage and support Azure server infrastructure (VMs, OS, backups, storage, networking). Monitor cost and implement Azure governance practices (e.g., tagging, reserved instances). Maintain cloud security posture (e.g., Defender, firewalls, identity/access). Automate operational tasks using scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI, Logic Apps). Perform patch management and ensure security compliance across environments. Contribute to monthly/quarterly health reports and environment reviews. Your Experience 3–5 years in infrastructure or cloud administration roles. Strong experience in Windows Server, Active Directory, and Azure IaaS components. Skilled in troubleshooting and resolving system and cloud performance issues. Experience with patching, backup (Commvault, Veeam, Avamar), DR (Azure Backup & ASR), and automation. Familiarity with monitoring platforms (LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, etc.). Knowledge of ITIL processes and change management. Scripting experience (PowerShell, Azure CLI). Relevant certifications (e.g., AZ-900, AZ-104, AZ-500, AZ-700, Commvault Certified Professional, VMware Certified Technical Associate (VCTA), VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), ITIL Foundation, Microsoft 365 Certified Fundamentals (MS-900)) preferred. Benefits As a valued member of ‘ Logicalis Asia Pacific MSC ' you will enjoy several benefits, such as; Supportive team environment: Confidential pulse checks tell us we are known for being "Unselfish with knowledge", "Flexible and Diverse" and "Give a shout-out and there will always be help" Pick your own adventure: Our people have moved from Helpdesk to Cloud-Engineering. Admin to Project/Program Management. Project Management to Product Development. If something interests you, we'll fund you to learn it, so you can become it! Breadth of experience and purpose: People here can have an idea, make a plan, and see it through. Our people enjoy genuinely impacting change and controlling their professional success. Flexible, modern, working arrangements: A hybrid working model that allows for a balance of productive remote working and in-person collaboration. Do I need to meet all the requirements to apply? No. Studies by several different sources have shown that, on average, men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the requirements. In contrast, women, non-binary, and neurodivergent people aim for closer to 90%! Please don’t let us miss out on everything you have to offer just because there is some upskilling to do. We can teach the specifics of the job. What we can’t teach is Character – ie Confidence, Capability, Curiosity. About us: We are Logicalis, Architects of Change™. We assist organizations in succeeding in a digital-first world by harnessing our collective technology expertise. Our lifecycle services, including cloud, connectivity, collaboration, and security, optimize operations, reduce risk, and empower employees. As a global tech service provider, we also deliver managed services to provide real-time visibility and insights across clients' digital ecosystems. With 7000+ employees in 27 countries, we help 10,000+ clients globally create sustainable outcomes through technology. For people living with disabilities or neurodiversity; adjustments and support will be made available to create a more comfortably aligned application process. If you need any specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.), and feel comfortable disclosing this, please let us know and we’ll be glad to facilitate.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Linux & AWS
review_candidates.description: Xestro is growing rapidly, and we’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer – Linux & AWS to help operate and modernise our established production infrastructure based in Maroochydore. About Xestro Xestro is an Australian healthcare software company that helps specialist doctors manage their patients and run their practices. Our cloud-based platform is used daily in hundreds of busy clinics across Australia by thousands of healthcare providers. We’re based in Maroochydore on the Sunshine Coast, close to the Sunshine Plaza, and have recently moved into a multi-storey office to support our next phase of growth. Our platform includes an established Linux, Apache, PHP and MySQL environment running on AWS, alongside a newer Kubernetes-based platform. We’re continuing to improve the reliability, security and automation of our existing infrastructure while progressively modernising the wider technology estate. The Role Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you’ll join our Platform team in our Maroochydore office and take an active role in managing the Linux and EC2 infrastructure supporting our core production platform. The work includes Linux fleet administration, AWS infrastructure, Apache and PHP services, RDS, monitoring and observability through Datadog, incident response, capacity management, patching and automation. You’ll help reduce reliance on manually managed systems, improve operational documentation and progressively bring the established platform under repeatable, version-controlled infrastructure management. You’ll also help set operational standards, identify systemic risks, guide technical decisions and share your Linux and production operations experience across the team. You’ll work closely with experienced software, platform and infrastructure engineers. This role suits someone who enjoys understanding how complex production systems actually behave, diagnosing problems from first principles and making practical improvements without losing sight of reliability. Once settled in, the role participates in a shared, paid on-call incident response rotation. About You You may come from a traditional systems administration, infrastructure engineering, cloud operations or SRE background. What Matters Most Is How You Approach The Work You take ownership of the systems you operate You are comfortable diagnosing production problems under pressure You understand Linux systems beyond running standard commands You value automation but can work safely with systems that are not yet fully automated You improve systems incrementally without disrupting critical services You communicate clearly and document what you learn You understand that operational work includes monitoring, maintenance and incident response You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You Have Strong professional Linux systems administration experience Experience operating business-critical production systems Experience operating and troubleshooting production web services, ideally Apache and PHP Strong AWS experience, particularly EC2, Auto Scaling Groups, VPC, IAM, load balancing, networking and DNS Strong TCP/IP, DNS, TLS and Linux networking fundamentals Experience with patching, operating system upgrades and fleet lifecycle management Shell scripting / Ansible / Terraform and infrastructure automation experience Experience with Datadog or a comparable observability platform, including infrastructure monitoring, logs, alerting and incident response Experience developing and maintaining operational runbooks Experience participating in an on-call or production support rotation Australian working rights and the ability to work from our Maroochydore office Highly Desirable Experience MySQL or Amazon Aurora operations, including replication, connection management and performance diagnosis GitLab CI/CD Docker or Kubernetes Security hardening, vulnerability management and compliance activities Backup, recovery and disaster-recovery practices Migrating manually managed infrastructure into repeatable, version-controlled automation Why Join Xestro? Job security in a long-established, growing healthcare SaaS company Meaningful work supporting systems used every day in real healthcare settings The opportunity to take ownership of important production infrastructure A practical modernisation program with experienced engineering peers Supportive, forward-thinking engineering and Platform teams Ongoing learning and a strong focus on security and reliability Sunshine Coast lifestyle with a healthy work-life balance
